facts.fact: Abt Global states the USAID-funded PSHPA trained private providers on National Health Management and Information System tools that feed data into DHIS2, distributed 4,000 registers to private facilities in all regions of Benin, and that the Ministry of Health combined this with public sector data.
facts.system: National Health Management and Information System (NHMIS) / DHIS2

systems.system: National Health Management and Information System (NHMIS)

note: A laboratory system; the body names no country and states no fact about a national health management information system.
Only the digital health strategy status is stated; nothing on a health management information system.
DHIS2 is named but its service and reporting are not described; the link from the geo-registry to it is stated as not operational.
Benin only hosts the workshop; not a pilot country.
Court equipment handover under PARAJ and online criminal record; no case management system, nor anything for this study, stated.
Only eSIGL for medicine stock and a death platform are named; no national routine health reporting system is stated.
Document says nothing on health information systems.
